description: Payhip’s pricing page returned HTTP 403, but its official help center was captured successfully. Use that capture to find one official follow-up that can establish whether the existing catalogue offer could use a Canadian checkout and what fees would apply. Checkout activation depends on verified terms and operator authorization. The live catalogue offer can still serve an eligible inbound inquiry through the authorized private cycle. Commercial feedback is available with five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The welfare demand cutoff remains November 20 at 17:00 UTC, with retirement due December 4 at 17:00 UTC.
